answers.reason: The research staff does not belong to the university leadership that makes up the senate.
Budget planning rounds are handled by leadership and administration, not research staff.
Appointment committees select professors, and research staff do not sit in bodies dealing with other groups' matters.
Faculty councils decide on faculty affairs, and research staff do not belong to that specific decision-making body.
Examination boards decide on examination matters of individual students, not research staff.
